subject.title: Add Tailscale Serve support for WSL gateways

question: Should generated WSL gateways support separately opt-in `gateway.auth.allowTailscale=true`, making verified tailnet identity and ACL policy a supported core authorization path?
rationale: The implementation can preserve existing credentials and isolate Tailscale administration, but accepting tailnet identity for authentication is a lasting security and product contract that code review cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve opt-in identity trust
options.body: Support the separately disclosed opt-in with root-owned Tailscale administration, preserved token/device flows, and focused security proof.

options.title: Ship transport only
options.body: Provision private Tailscale Serve connectivity while always requiring OpenClaw token or paired-device authentication.

options.title: Defer core integration
options.body: Pause the feature until long-term ownership and the authentication threat model are established.

recommendation.title: Approve opt-in identity trust
recommendation.body: Support the separately disclosed opt-in with root-owned Tailscale administration, preserved token/device flows, and focused security proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The account-associated review discussion most directly owns the currently documented privilege and authentication decision packet.
